request: writing into tag buffer U64 at offset

candidates.prompt: One SQUARE flat software icon on white for writing into a tag buffer a value of datatype U64. Across the TOP place exactly U64 in HUGE BOLD BLACK characters with large WHITE GAPS between each character. Capital I, if present, MUST have broad horizontal top and bottom bars, clearly different from digit 1. The exact label U64 must dominate the image and remain legible at 30x18 pixels. No other text, no shadows. Below the type show a large BLUE rectangular buffer and a bold ORANGE horizontal arrow pointing TOWARD the buffer. The arrow must clearly show data going into the buffer. Center the entire design within the square.

signature.composition: Below the type show a large BLUE rectangular buffer and a bold ORANGE horizontal arrow pointing TOWARD the buffer. The arrow must clearly show data going into the buffer.

30x18.evidence: U64 is distinguishable and the arrow points into the buffer.

source.evidence: U64 appears above a rectangular buffer and inward rightward arrow, showing transfer into the buffer.

29x29.evidence: U64 and the rectangular buffer and inward rightward arrow remain visible.
